policy: Skill maintenance is a governed source-to-runtime workflow. External workbench repositories may contribute manifest, validation, packaging, and public-template patterns, but they must not become a second source of truth beside the local research-autopilot source tree and catalog/schema validators.

adopted_as: R plotting micro-patterns for scatter, raincloud, weighted regression, and rich-text export
Chinese thesis DOCX manifest and placeholder workflow as explicit opt-in pattern

adoption_options.label: 直接安装外部工作台
adoption_options.description: 把外部 codex-skills-workbench 作为本地技能主工作台，并让它直接安装到 Codex runtime。
strengths: 源笔记到 skill 的转换链路清楚
有 manifest 和安装脚本
适合管理独立小 skill 包
risks: 会形成第二套技能源规则层
可能覆盖 research-autopilot 插件技能镜像
外部目录结构不理解本地 schema、route、profile 和质量门
容易误碰用户受保护蒸馏 skill

adoption_options.label: 本地合同优先吸收
adoption_options.description: 只吸收外部工作台的 manifest、source-note、验证、安装边界和脱敏思路，把它们写成本地 catalog/schema/validator 规则；运行时仍由本仓同步脚本和 validate_research_stack 管理。
strengths: 不破坏本地 research-autopilot 总入口
能约束未来新增 skill 的源文件、运行时镜像和验证边界
能复用外部工作台的清晰维护模式
能和现有 runtime drift 校验共存
risks: 需要维护一个新的 policy 文件和 validator
不是完整 GUI 工作台
不能自动把外部 skill 变成可用技能

adoption_options.label: 为所有技能建立源笔记镜像
adoption_options.description: 把每个可编辑 skill 都拆成 source-notes 与 packaged SKILL.md 两层，由 manifest 驱动同步。
strengths: 便于把长说明和运行包分开维护
能减少直接编辑 runtime skill 的概率
risks: 会大幅改变当前 research-autopilot 插件目录结构
短期会增加源文件和 packaged 文件漂移风险

adoption_options.label: 运行时技能编辑器
adoption_options.description: 让工具直接读写 <CODEX_HOME>/skills 下的 runtime skill，再反向导出到仓库。
risks: 会破坏 source-to-runtime 单向同步
会误把缓存和用户私有 skill 当成源文件

local_boundaries.external_repo_policy: External repositories may be cloned under skills/outputs for review, but no external source directory is installed or treated as canonical until skill-vetter, catalog/schema updates, tests, and runtime sync pass.

package_contracts.scope: Core local research skills owned by the local environment.
validation: relevant unit tests for touched skill

package_contracts.scope: User-installed or plugin-exposed Codex skills outside the repository source tree.
package_contracts.canonical_location: none unless explicitly mirrored into this repository
validation: do not write unless the user explicitly approves and the protected path policy allows it
port stable changes back to repository source before syncing

package_contracts.scope: Third-party repositories reviewed as pattern sources.
package_contracts.canonical_location: skills/outputs/external-vetting or skills/outputs/x temporary review clone

validation: validate_agents_contract when promoted to environment template
project quality gates before multi-agent execution

borrowed_patterns.local_adaptation: Use skill_catalog.json and this workbench policy as the canonical inventory for local skills, categories, source/runtime boundaries, and invocation posture.
borrowed_patterns.not_adopted: Do not add a second manifests/skills.json that competes with skill_catalog.json.

borrowed_patterns.local_adaptation: For future public or narrow skills, keep the longer design note in references/ and keep SKILL.md as the activation contract.
borrowed_patterns.not_adopted: Do not split every current research-autopilot skill into generated source-note packages during this pass.

borrowed_patterns.local_adaptation: Any source-to-runtime skill sync must run local validators before commit and validate_research_stack after sync.
borrowed_patterns.not_adopted: Do not use the external install-local-skills.ps1 to write the local Codex runtime.

borrowed_patterns.local_adaptation: External promotion or VELA handoff must remove private paths, account identifiers, non-public project names, local output manifests, secrets, and dataset-specific facts.
borrowed_patterns.not_adopted: Do not treat the private local environment as a publishable template without a separate scrub pass.

borrowed_patterns.local_adaptation: Reference-fulltext acquisition and evidence-based literature screening may borrow the no-dedup candidate table, priority table, PDF-only output folder, non-PDF cache separation, retry log, and dedup manifest model.
borrowed_patterns.not_adopted: Do not install the upstream PubMed/Europe PMC runtime as the default social-science acquisition path; biomedical APIs are used only when the topic calls for them.

borrowed_patterns.local_adaptation: Figure-table-studio and research-figure-studio choose R, Python, PowerPoint, vector tools, spreadsheets, or image2 from final destination, data shape, modeling need, desktop visibility, and reproducibility requirements.
borrowed_patterns.not_adopted: Do not add a separate plotting-tool-selection skill that competes with the local figure routes.

borrowed_patterns.local_adaptation: Use the scatter, raincloud, weighted-regression, weighted-data, and ggplot2 rich-text notes as optional adapters inside figure-table-studio when a social-science empirical figure needs the same visual form.
borrowed_patterns.not_adopted: Do not make ecology-specific trait, hypervolume, or phylogeny workflows default social-science skills.

borrowed_patterns.local_adaptation: Presentation work may borrow the figure/table manifest, custom image-wall layout, slide-size-first placement, aspect-ratio preservation, and preview/PDF QA pattern.
borrowed_patterns.not_adopted: Do not require visible PowerPoint COM automation by default; use it only after the user asks or confirms visible desktop generation.

borrowed_patterns.local_adaptation: Chinese thesis or long-form Word work can borrow project manifests, decisions logs, figure/table/code/data manifests, placeholder tokens, and template-preserving DOCX output when the user explicitly asks for a thesis studio flow.
borrowed_patterns.not_adopted: Do not auto-trigger a thesis-specific skill for ordinary论文写作、DOCX导出、中文期刊排版或学术润色。

borrowed_patterns.local_adaptation: Skill instructions should call local envctl/scripts through stable repository paths and avoid hard-coded stale helper paths.
borrowed_patterns.not_adopted: Do not import ARIS helper cache or provider runtime as a new main runtime.

borrowed_patterns.local_adaptation: Keep task_type, data_access_level, quality_gate_required, stage_scope, and subagent_allowed in skill_catalog/routing metadata and validate them through stack checks.
borrowed_patterns.not_adopted: Do not require every runtime mirror skill to carry all metadata directly in SKILL.md frontmatter.

required_workflow.action: Clone or inspect the external candidate in the repository output review area and record source URL, observed commit or archive state, and file inventory.
required_workflow.output: external review notes or updated external_systems_research.json entry

required_workflow.action: Classify the candidate as keep, adapt, watch, or reject using task relevance, maintenance, Codex compatibility, permission risk, overlap, and fallback cost.
Translate accepted patterns into local catalog, schema, validator, skill, or test changes; never bulk-copy an external runtime.
If research-autopilot skills changed, run sync_research_autopilot_skills.ps1 to update standalone and plugin-cache mirrors.
Run relevant unit tests, envctl validate targets, mandatory validators, and validate_research_stack before committing.
required_workflow.output: clean worktree or explicit residual risk report

safety_rules.rule: Do not treat edits under <CODEX_HOME>/skills as canonical environment changes; port durable changes back to repository source first.
safety_rules.failure_action: Stop and report runtime/source drift; do not sync until the repository source is updated.

safety_rules.rule: Do not install, execute, or mirror third-party skill bundles before skill-vetter review, local adaptation decision, and validator coverage.
safety_rules.failure_action: Keep the candidate in review-only status.

safety_rules.rule: Do not promote local paths, account IDs, cookies, project names, non-public data identifiers, or generated output manifests into public templates or VELA-facing artifacts.
safety_rules.failure_action: Block promotion and require a scrub report.

safety_rules.rule: Do not sync research-autopilot skill changes into runtime mirrors unless the relevant source files are tracked and local tests or validators cover the changed contract.
safety_rules.failure_action: Leave runtime untouched and return a source validation blocker.

safety_rules.rule: Do not write, sync, overwrite, clean, or mutate protected runtime skill paths from the public VELA distribution.
safety_rules.failure_action: Stop and report the protected runtime boundary.
